```{r markov-cap}
if (listo) {
  q1 <- p_base$qx[1]; pr_g <- p_from_h(p_base$lambda[["G"]] * p_base$rr_deep, 1); d_egd <- p_base$c_att * p_base$se_egd; d_eus <- p_base$c_att * p_base$se_eus
  ftab <- tibble(
    Transition = c("SU → SP and DU → DP (progression)", "Any living state → DEATH", "SP → TR (detected and completely resected)",
                   "SP → SU (detected, incomplete resection)", "SP → SP (not detected)", "Staying in the same state"),
    Formula = c("(1 − q) × p<sub>prog</sub>, with p<sub>prog</sub> = 1 − exp(−λ<sub>histology</sub> × RR<sub>layer</sub>)",
                "q = annual probability of death at the cohort's age (INE life table, weighted by sex)",
                "d × p<sub>complete</sub> × (1 − q), with d = attendance × sensitivity of the surveillance test",
                "d × (1 − p<sub>complete</sub>) × (1 − q) × (1 − p<sub>prog</sub>)",
                "(1 − d) × (1 − q), plus returned patients who progress again in the same year",
                "1 − sum of the other outgoing probabilities"),
    Inputs = c(paste0("λ<sub>GIST</sub> = ", fmt_n(p_base$lambda[["G"]], 4), " (H05); RR<sub>deep</sub> = ", fmt_n(p_base$rr_deep, 2), " (H02); p<sub>prog</sub> = ", fmt_n(pr_g, 4)),
               paste0("q = ", fmt_n(q1, 4), " in year 1 (M01, P01, P02)"),
               paste0("EGD: d = ", fmt_n(p_base$c_att, 3), " (V07) × ", fmt_n(p_base$se_egd, 3), " (V08) = ", fmt_n(d_egd, 3), "; EUS: d = ", fmt_n(p_base$c_att, 3), " × ", fmt_n(p_base$se_eus, 3), " (V09) = ", fmt_n(d_eus, 3), "; p<sub>complete</sub> = ", fmt_n(p_base$er_complete, 2), " (T01)"),
               "As above", "As above", "—"))
  sjd_kable(ftab, format = "html", escape = FALSE, caption = tab_n("How the annual transition probabilities are calculated (SU = surveillance, unprogressed; SP = surveillance, progressed; DU/DP = discharged, unprogressed/progressed; TR = treated; DEATH = death from any cause)"),
            nota = paste("Events within each cycle follow this order: (1) scheduled visit and detection, (2) background death, (3) biological progression. In years without a scheduled visit, d = 0. For benign lesions a detected progression is sampled first: with probability", fmt_n(p_base$fnb_yield, 3), "(D01) the sample is diagnostic and the patient is discharged (SP → DU); otherwise a diagnostic resection is performed (SP → TR).", id_legend(c("H05", "H02", "M01", "P01", "V07", "T01", "D01")))) |> cat_k()
  strata <- expand_grid(Histology = c("B", "G", "N"), Layer = c("sup", "deep")) |>
    mutate(prog = map2_dbl(Histology, Layer, ~ p_from_h(p_base$lambda[[.x]] * (if (.y == "deep") p_base$rr_deep else 1), 1)))
  sjd_kable(strata |> transmute(Histology = c(B = "Benign", G = "GIST", N = "NET")[Histology],
                                Layer = ifelse(Layer == "sup", "Superficial", "Deep (muscularis propria)"),
                                `Annual probability of suspicious progression` = fmt_n(prog, 4)),
            caption = tab_n("Annual progression probabilities in every stratum of the model"),
            nota = paste0("Detection of an existing progression at a scheduled visit = attendance × sensitivity: ",
                          fmt_n(p_base$c_att * p_base$se_egd, 3), " with EGD and ", fmt_n(p_base$c_att * p_base$se_eus, 3),
                          " with EUS. In the surveillance strategies (A and B) visits occur at 6 months and then every ", p_base$int_egd, " years; in strategy C, after the 1-year EGD control, EUS and EGD alternate every ", p_base$int_c, " years. In non-visit years the detection probability is 0.")) |> cat_k()
  sjd_kable(init |> mutate(across(SU:TR, ~ fmt_n(.x, 3))) |>
              rename(`Surveillance, no progression` = SU, `Discharged, no progression` = DU, Treated = TR),
            caption = tab_n("Initial state distribution of GIST lesions (deep layer) in each strategy"),
            nota = "Surveillance strategies start everyone under surveillance. With EUS plus EBL-SINK, the starting state depends on technical success, SINK diagnosis, attendance at the 1-year EGD control, lesion disappearance and residual disease; lesions that persist return to surveillance (EUS and EGD alternating every 2 years).") |> cat_k()
  # Supplementary tables for the manuscript: every stratum, every test (Figure 1B-D show states and arrows only)
  hist_lab  <- c(B = "Benign", G = "GIST", N = "NET")
  layer_lab <- c(sup = "Superficial", deep = "Deep (muscularis propria)")
  tr_order <- c("SU → SU", "SU → SP", "SU → DEATH", "SP → SP", "SP → TR", "SP → SU", "SP → DU", "SP → DP", "SP → DEATH",
                "DU → DU", "DU → DP", "DU → DEATH", "DP → DP", "DP → DEATH", "TR → TR", "TR → DEATH")
  strata_cols <- expand_grid(Histology = c("B", "G", "N"), Layer = c("sup", "deep")) |>
    mutate(col = paste0(hist_lab[Histology], ", ", tolower(c(sup = "Superficial", deep = "Deep")[Layer])))
  tp_novisit <- function(h, layer) {                         # year without a scheduled visit: detection = 0
    pr <- p_from_h(p_base$lambda[[h]] * (if (layer == "deep") p_base$rr_deep else 1), 1); q <- p_base$qx[1]
    tibble(from = c("SU", "SU", "SU", "SP", "SP", "DU", "DU", "DU", "DP", "DP", "TR", "TR"),
           to   = c("SU", "SP", "D", "SP", "D", "DU", "DP", "D", "DP", "D", "TR", "D"),
           p    = c((1 - q) * (1 - pr), (1 - q) * pr, q, 1 - q, q, (1 - q) * (1 - pr), (1 - q) * pr, q, 1 - q, q, 1 - q, q))
  }
  tp_all <- expand_grid(Year = c("EGD", "EUS", "none"), strata_cols) |>
    mutate(tp = pmap(list(Year, Histology, Layer), function(y, h, l) if (y == "none") tp_novisit(h, l) else tp_stratum(h, l, y))) |>
    unnest(tp) |> mutate(to = ifelse(to == "D", "DEATH", to), Transition = paste(from, "→", to)) |>
    filter(from != "D")
  stopifnot(all(abs(tapply(tp_all$p, paste(tp_all$Year, tp_all$col, tp_all$from), sum) - 1) < 1e-12))   # each row of each matrix sums to 1
  # Compact layout: transitions that do not depend on the type of year are shown once; only the rows leaving SP change
  tp_w <- tp_all |> select(Year, Transition, col, p) |> pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = p)
  pick <- function(y, tr) tp_w |> filter(Year == y, Transition == tr) |> select(all_of(strata_cols$col))
  common <- c("SU → SU", "SU → SP", "DU → DU", "DU → DP", "DP → DP", "TR → TR", "SU → DEATH")
  for (tr in common) for (y in c("EUS", "none")) stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unlist(pick("EGD", tr)), unlist(pick(y, tr)))))   # identical in every year
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unlist(pick("EGD", "DP → DP")), unlist(pick("EGD", "TR → TR")))),
            all(abs(tp_all$p[tp_all$to == "DEATH"] - p_base$qx[1]) < 1e-12))                                               # death identical from every state
  sp_rows <- c("SP → SP", "SP → TR", "SP → SU", "SP → DU", "SP → DP")
  tp_tab <- bind_rows(
    tibble(Transition = c("SU → SU", "SU → SP", "DU → DU", "DU → DP", "DP → DP, TR → TR", "Any state → DEATH")) |>
      bind_cols(bind_rows(pick("EGD", "SU → SU"), pick("EGD", "SU → SP"), pick("EGD", "DU → DU"), pick("EGD", "DU → DP"), pick("EGD", "DP → DP"), pick("EGD", "SU → DEATH"))),
    map_dfr(c("EGD", "EUS", "none"), function(y) {
      trs <- intersect(sp_rows, tp_w$Transition[tp_w$Year == y])
      tibble(Transition = trs) |> bind_cols(map_dfr(trs, ~ pick(y, .x)))
    })) |>
    mutate(across(all_of(strata_cols$col), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x) | .x < 1e-12, "—", fmt_n(.x, 4))))
  n_sp <- map_int(c("EGD", "EUS", "none"), function(y) length(intersect(sp_rows, tp_w$Transition[tp_w$Year == y])))
  cut1 <- 6; cut2 <- cut1 + n_sp[1]; cut3 <- cut2 + n_sp[2]
  sjd_kable(tp_tab, caption = tab_n("Annual transition probabilities by stratum (base case, first model year)"),
            nota = paste0("Only the transitions leaving SP depend on the type of year; all other transitions are the same in every year. ",
                          "SP → DEATH = ", fmt_n(p_base$qx[1], 4), " in every type of year; the probabilities leaving each state sum to 1. ",
                          "Death is the annual probability at the cohort's starting age (", round(v_base[["P01"]]), " years), weighted by sex; it increases each year with age (INE life tables). ",
                          "The strategy determines which test is used and when: strategy A, EGD at 6 months and then every ", p_base$int_egd,
                          " years; strategy B, EUS for deep-layer and EGD for superficial lesions on the same schedule; strategy C, EGD control at 1 year and then EUS and EGD alternating every ", p_base$int_c,
                          " years. Detection at a visit = attendance (", fmt_n(p_base$c_att, 3), ") × sensitivity of the test (EGD ", fmt_n(p_base$se_egd, 3), "; EUS ", fmt_n(p_base$se_eus, 3), "). ",
                          "A detected progression in a GIST or NET is resected; incomplete resection returns the patient to surveillance (SP → SU). ",
                          "In a benign lesion it is sampled and, if the sample is diagnostic, the patient is discharged (SP → DU, or SP → DP if it progresses again in the same year). ",
                          "— = transition not possible. SU = surveillance, unprogressed; SP = surveillance, progressed (not yet detected); DU = discharged, unprogressed; DP = discharged, progressed; ",
                          "TR = treated (resected or eradicated); DEATH = death from any cause.")) |>
    kableExtra::pack_rows("Transitions that are the same in every year", 1, cut1) |>
    kableExtra::pack_rows("Transitions from SP: year with an EGD visit", cut1 + 1, cut2) |>
    kableExtra::pack_rows("Transitions from SP: year with an EUS visit", cut2 + 1, cut3) |>
    kableExtra::pack_rows("Transitions from SP: year without a visit", cut3 + 1, nrow(tp_tab)) |> cat_k()
  init_all <- expand_grid(Strategy = c("A", "B", "C"), Layer = c("sup", "deep")) |>
    mutate(tr0 = map2(Strategy, Layer, ~ run_stratum(p_base, .x, .y, 1)$trace[1, ])) |>
    expand_grid(Histology = c("B", "G", "N")) |>
    mutate(v = map2(tr0, Histology, function(t0, h) { v <- t0[st(MGMT, h)]; setNames(v / sum(v), MGMT) })) |>
    mutate(SU = map_dbl(v, "SU"), DU = map_dbl(v, "DU"), TR = map_dbl(v, "TR")) |>
    arrange(Strategy, Histology, match(Layer, c("sup", "deep")))
  sjd_kable(init_all |> transmute(Strategy = S_LAB[Strategy], Histology = hist_lab[Histology], Layer = layer_lab[Layer],
                                  `SU (surveillance)` = fmt_n(SU, 4), `DU (discharged)` = fmt_n(DU, 4), `TR (treated)` = fmt_n(TR, 4)),
            caption = tab_n("Starting state distribution by strategy and stratum (base case)"),
            nota = paste0("Proportion of each stratum in each state at the start of the model. In the surveillance strategies (A and B) every lesion starts under surveillance. ",
                          "With EUS plus EBL-SINK, the starting state results from the initial EBL-SINK and the 1-year EGD control: TR = lesion disappeared and eradicated; ",
                          "DU = discharged without eradication (benign histology on SINK, or lesion disappeared with residual disease left); ",
                          "SU = technical failure, persisting lesion or no 1-year control. No lesion starts in a progressed state (SP or DP).")) |> cat_k()
  clear_float()
  html_note(paste0(
    "<b>Order of events in each annual cycle:</b> (1) scheduled visit with detection among attenders; ",
    "(2) background death; (3) biological progression, independent of detection; (4) person-years recorded with half-cycle correction. ",
    "Costs and effects of each cycle are discounted at mid-cycle; those of the initial procedure are not discounted."))
  html_flag(paste0(
    "<b>Declared structural simplifications.</b> (a) In the EUS plus EBL-SINK strategy, lesions that persist at the 1-year EGD control, technical failures and patients who miss that control are followed with EUS and EGD alternating every 2 years (EUS at years 3, 7, 11…; EGD at years 5, 9, 13…), as defined in the study protocol; a progression detected at these visits is managed as in the surveillance strategies (EUS-FNB and resection); ",
    "(b) incomplete resection returns the patient to surveillance; (c) background mortality is weighted by the proportion of women at baseline; ",
    "(d) GIST-specific mortality for small lesions is 0 in the base case, a declared assumption (section 7, assumption 9)."))
}
```

## Base-case results {.tabset}

```{r base-run}
OUT_LAB <- c(cost_disc = "Total discounted cost (€)", n_egd = "EGD", n_eus = "Surveillance EUS",
             n_ebl = "EBL-SINK procedures", n_fnb = "Sampling procedures (EUS-FNB)", n_er = "Endoscopic resections",
             n_er_benign = "Resections of benign lesions", n_ae_ebl = "AEs of EUS plus EBL-SINK", n_ae_er = "AEs of resection",
             n_ae_endo = "AEs of diagnostic EGD/EUS", n_ae_fnb = "AEs of EUS-FNB",
             prog_all = "Suspicious progression events", prog_neo_missed = "Missed neoplastic progressions",
             false_reassurance = "Discharges with residual disease (neoplasm not eradicated)", py_surv = "Person-years under surveillance",
             py_undet = "Person-years with an undetected progressed neoplasm", deaths = "Deaths (background)")
# Burden of missed disease: person-years spent in SP or DP with a GIST or NET (trapezoid over the trace)
py_undet <- function(x) {
  tr <- x$trace[, c("SP_G", "SP_N", "DP_G", "DP_N"), drop = FALSE]; k <- rowSums(tr)
  sum((head(k, -1) + tail(k, -1)) / 2)
}
# Same, discounted at the model rate (mid-cycle, as for every other event: cycle t weighted by 1 / (1 + r)^(t - 0.5))
py_undet_d <- function(x, r) {
  tr <- x$trace[, c("SP_G", "SP_N", "DP_G", "DP_N"), drop = FALSE]; k <- rowSums(tr)
  sum((head(k, -1) + tail(k, -1)) / 2 / (1 + r)^(seq_len(length(k) - 1) - 0.5))
}
if (listo) {
  p_base <- build_p(v_base)
  res_base <- run_all(p_base, N = 1000)
  # Cost-consequence table (editor comment 10; CHEERS 2022): discounted cost, undiscounted events and resource use in natural units (base_tbl);
  # the discounted effect (missed progressions, used in every cost-effect measure) is reported alongside (base_tbl_d)
  base_tbl <- sapply(res_base, function(x) c(cost_disc = x$cost_disc, x$events, py_undet = py_undet(x)))
  base_tbl <- base_tbl[names(OUT_LAB), ]
  base_tbl_d <- sapply(res_base, function(x) c(cost_disc = x$cost_disc, x$events_disc, py_undet = py_undet_d(x, p_base$disc)))
  base_tbl_d <- base_tbl_d[names(OUT_LAB), ]
}
```

### Table {-}

```{r base-tbl}
if (!listo) {
  html_warn("Results on hold: the parameter registry is not complete (parameters without a value are listed above).")
} else {
  bt <- as.data.frame(base_tbl) |> rownames_to_column("k") |>
    mutate(Outcome = OUT_LAB[k], across(A:C, ~ fmt_n(.x, 2)),
           `C − A` = fmt_n(base_tbl[, "C"] - base_tbl[, "A"], 2), `C − B` = fmt_n(base_tbl[, "C"] - base_tbl[, "B"], 2)) |>
    select(Outcome, A, B, C, `C − A`, `C − B`)
  md <- base_tbl_d["prog_neo_missed", ]
  bt <- bind_rows(bt[seq_len(which(bt$Outcome == OUT_LAB[["prog_neo_missed"]])), ],
                  tibble(Outcome = "Missed neoplastic progressions, discounted at 3% (effect measure)", A = fmt_n(md[["A"]], 2), B = fmt_n(md[["B"]], 2), C = fmt_n(md[["C"]], 2),
                         `C − A` = fmt_n(md[["C"]] - md[["A"]], 2), `C − B` = fmt_n(md[["C"]] - md[["B"]], 2)),
                  bt[-seq_len(which(bt$Outcome == OUT_LAB[["prog_neo_missed"]])), ])
  names(bt)[2:4] <- c("A (EGD)", "B (EUS)", "C (EUS plus EBL-SINK)")
  sjd_kable(bt, caption = tab_n("Costs and consequences per 1,000 patients, base case"),
            nota = paste0("A = ", sub("^[ABC]\\. ", "", S_LAB[["A"]]), "; B = ", sub("^[ABC]\\. ", "", S_LAB[["B"]]), "; C = ", sub("^[ABC]\\. ", "", S_LAB[["C"]]), ". C − A and C − B = EUS plus EBL-SINK minus each surveillance strategy. ",
                          "Cost discounted at 3% per year; clinical events and resource use undiscounted, in natural units (editor comment 10; CHEERS 2022). ",
                          "The discounted number of missed neoplastic progressions is the effect measure used in every cost-effect analysis. 20-year horizon.")) |> cat_k()
  clear_float()
}

### Figure {-}

```{r base-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
if (listo) {
  keyv <- c("cost_disc", "prog_neo_missed", "py_undet", "py_surv", "n_er_benign", "false_reassurance")
  pd <- as.data.frame(t(base_tbl[keyv, ])) |> rownames_to_column("s") |> pivot_longer(-s) |>
    mutate(Estrategia = factor(S_LAB[s], levels = S_LAB))
  # Panel titles: bold letter, plain description; wrapped lines continue in the subtitle with the same style
  ttl <- lapply(seq_along(keyv), function(i) strwrap(paste0(LETTERS[i], ") ", OUT_LAB[[keyv[i]]]), width = 30))
  base_panel <- function(i) {
    ln <- ttl[[i]]
    ggplot(dplyr::filter(pd, name == keyv[i]), aes(x = Estrategia, y = value, fill = Estrategia)) + geom_col(width = 0.75) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = strat_cols, drop = FALSE) + scale_y_continuous(labels = eur_lab) +
      labs(title = bquote(bold(.(paste0(LETTERS[i], ")"))) ~ .(sub("^[A-Z]\\) ", "", ln[1]))),
           subtitle = if (length(ln) > 1) paste(ln[-1], collapse = "\n") else NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
      theme_sjd() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
            plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 1)),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
            plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 4))
  }
  p_grid <- wrap_plots(lapply(seq_along(keyv), base_panel), ncol = 3) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  y_ttl  <- wrap_elements(full = grid::textGrob("Per 1,000 patients", rot = 90, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12)))
  p_base <- y_ttl + wrap_elements(full = p_grid) + plot_layout(widths = c(0.035, 1))
  print(p_base)
  fig_cap("Main costs and consequences by strategy, base case", "Cost discounted at 3%; clinical events and resource use undiscounted")
  save_fig(p_base, "fig_resultados_base", 9, 6)
  clear_float()
  html_interp("Each panel has its own scale. Cost and the consequences in terms of benefit and harm must be read together; by construction, no strategy dominates in every dimension.")
}
```

### Interpretation {-}

```{r base-interp}
if (listo) {
  dC <- base_tbl["cost_disc", "C"] - base_tbl["cost_disc", "A"]
  dM <- base_tbl["prog_neo_missed", "A"] - base_tbl["prog_neo_missed", "C"]
  cuad <- if (dC < 0 && dM > 0) "EUS plus EBL-SINK is less costly and avoids more undetected progressions (dominant)" else
          if (dC > 0 && dM < 0) "EUS plus EBL-SINK is more costly and leaves more progressions undetected (dominated)" else
          if (dC > 0 && dM > 0) "EUS plus EBL-SINK is more costly and avoids more undetected progressions: the cost per progression avoided must be weighed" else
          "EUS plus EBL-SINK is less costly but leaves more progressions undetected: the savings per additional progression must be weighed"
  dU <- base_tbl["py_undet", "A"] - base_tbl["py_undet", "C"]
  dMd <- base_tbl_d["prog_neo_missed", "A"] - base_tbl_d["prog_neo_missed", "C"]
  html_interp(paste0("Compared with EGD surveillance, the cost difference is ", fmt_n(dC / 1000, 2), " € per patient (discounted) and the difference in missed neoplastic progressions is ",
                     fmt_n(dM, 2), " per 1,000 patients (undiscounted; ", fmt_n(dMd, 2), " discounted at 3%, the effect used in the cost per progression avoided). ", cuad, ". ",
                     "Measured as time, EUS plus EBL-SINK ", if (dU >= 0) "reduces" else "increases", " the time lived with an undetected progressed neoplasm by ",
                     fmt_n(abs(dU), 1), " person-years per 1,000 patients over 20 years (", fmt_n(base_tbl["py_undet", "A"], 1), " with EGD surveillance vs ",
                     fmt_n(base_tbl["py_undet", "C"], 1), " with EUS plus EBL-SINK)."))
} else html_warn("Interpretation on hold until the pending parameters are available.")

# Secondary analyses

## Results by layer of origin {.tabset}

Lesions arising from the deep layer (muscularis propria) grow more often and disappear less often after banding than superficial ones, and strategy B follows them with EUS. To see whether the comparison differs between the two groups, the model is run twice: once assuming all lesions are superficial, and once assuming all are deep. The table shows the cost and the missed progressions of each strategy in each case.

### Table {-}

```{r layer-tbl}
if (!listo) html_warn("Waiting for the pending parameters.") else {
  lay <- map_dfr(c("A", "B", "C"), function(s) map_dfr(c("sup", "deep"), function(L) {
    o <- res_base[[s]]$strata[[L]]
    tibble(Strategy = S_LAB[s], Layer = ifelse(L == "sup", "Superficial", "Deep"),
           `Discounted cost (€/patient)` = o$cost_disc / 1000,
           `Missed neoplastic progressions` = o$events["prog_neo_missed"],
           `Benign resections` = o$events["n_er_benign"])
  }))
  sjd_kable(lay |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ fmt_n(.x, 2))),
            caption = tab_n("Results by layer-of-origin stratum, per 1,000 patients"),
            nota = "Each stratum is simulated as if the whole cohort belonged to it.") |> cat_k()
  clear_float()
}
```

## Conditions under which EUS plus EBL-SINK is dominant {.tabset}

```{r dom-calc}
if (listo) {
  # Deterministic grid: attendance at each visit × interval between examinations (EGD and EUS)
  run_sc <- function(v, int, H = HORIZON) { p <- build_p(v, H); p$int_egd <- int; p$int_eus <- int; run_all(p, 1000) }
  grid_tw <- expand_grid(att = sort(unique(c(round(v_base[["V07"]], 3), seq(0.5, 1, by = 0.1)))), int = c(1, 2, 3))
  tw <- pmap_dfr(grid_tw, function(att, int) {
    v <- v_base; v["V07"] <- att; r <- run_sc(v, int)
    tibble(att = att, int = int,
           dC_A = (r$C$cost_disc - r$A$cost_disc) / 1000, dE_A = r$A$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]],
           dC_B = (r$C$cost_disc - r$B$cost_disc) / 1000, dE_B = r$B$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]])
  }) |> mutate(dom_A = dC_A < 0 & dE_A > 0, dom_B = dC_B < 0 & dE_B > 0)
  # Fine map for the plot
  fine <- pmap_dfr(expand_grid(att = seq(0.3, 1, by = 0.05), int = c(1, 2, 3)), function(att, int) {
    v <- v_base; v["V07"] <- att; r <- run_sc(v, int)
    tibble(att = att, int = int,
           `EUS plus EBL-SINK vs surveillance with EGD` = paste(sign(r$C$cost_disc - r$A$cost_disc), sign(r$A$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]])),
           `EUS plus EBL-SINK vs surveillance with selective EUS` = paste(sign(r$C$cost_disc - r$B$cost_disc), sign(r$B$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]])))
  }) |> pivot_longer(-c(att, int), names_to = "cmp", values_to = "q") |>
    mutate(Result = case_when(q == "-1 1" ~ "EUS plus EBL-SINK dominant (lower cost and fewer undetected progressions)",
                              q == "1 1"  ~ "EUS plus EBL-SINK more costly and more effective",
                              q == "-1 -1" ~ "EUS plus EBL-SINK less costly and less effective",
                              TRUE ~ "EUS plus EBL-SINK dominated"))
  # Lifetime horizon: check of the robustness of dominance
  H_life <- 100 - round(v_base[["P01"]])
  life <- pmap_dfr(expand_grid(att = c(round(v_base[["V07"]], 3), 0.7, 1), int = c(1, 3)), function(att, int) {
    v <- v_base; v["V07"] <- att; r <- run_sc(v, int, H_life)
    tibble(att = att, int = int, dC_A = (r$C$cost_disc - r$A$cost_disc) / 1000, dE_A = r$A$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]],
           dC_B = (r$C$cost_disc - r$B$cost_disc) / 1000, dE_B = r$B$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]])
  })
  # Lifetime scenarios in which EUS plus EBL-SINK leaves more progressions undetected than the comparator (text helper)
  life_neg <- bind_rows(life |> filter(dE_A < 0) |> transmute(cmp = "EGD", int, att, dE = dE_A),
                        life |> filter(dE_B < 0) |> transmute(cmp = "selective EUS", int, att, dE = dE_B))
  life_neg_txt <- if (nrow(life_neg) == 0) "" else paste(with(life_neg, paste0(cmp, " surveillance ", ifelse(int == 1, "every year", paste("every", int, "years")),
                                                                         " with ", fmt_n(100 * att, 0), "% attendance (", fmt_n(dE, 2), " per 1,000)")), collapse = "; ")
}
```

```{r dom-psa-setup}
if (listo) {
  # Probability of dominance in key scenarios (probabilistic analysis with attendance fixed)
  n_dom <- params$n_dom
  sc_dom <- tibble(Scenario = c(paste0("Annual, observed attendance (", fmt_n(100 * v_base[["V07"]], 1), "%)"), "Annual, attendance 70%",
                                 "Every 2 years, attendance 90%", "Every 3 years (ESGE), attendance 80%"),
                   int = c(1, 1, 2, 3), att = c(v_base[["V07"]], 0.7, 0.9, 0.8))
  n_cores <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "unix") min(4L, parallel::detectCores()) else 1L
  dom_one <- function(k) {
    set.seed(2027 + k)                                   # own seed per scenario
    M_k <- draw_psa(n_dom); int <- sc_dom$int[k]; att <- sc_dom$att[k]
    res <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(n_dom), function(i) {
      v <- M_k[i, ]; v["V07"] <- att; r <- run_sc(v, int)
      c(dC_A = r$C$cost_disc - r$A$cost_disc, dE_A = r$A$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]],
        dC_B = r$C$cost_disc - r$B$cost_disc, dE_B = r$B$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]])
    }, mc.cores = n_cores)
    m <- do.call(rbind, res)
    tibble(Scenario = sc_dom$Scenario[k], pA = mean(m[, "dC_A"] < 0 & m[, "dE_A"] > 0), pB = mean(m[, "dC_B"] < 0 & m[, "dE_B"] > 0))
  }
}
```

## Budget impact (exploratory, open cohort) {.tabset}

This exploratory analysis was not requested by the editor; the main analysis remains the closed cohort (section 8.4). It follows the ISPOR recommendations for budget impact analysis: undiscounted annual spending over five years, comparing current practice with scenarios of progressive adoption of the new technique.

```{r bia-calc}
if (listo) {
  frac_mod <- flow$an / flow$total                     # fraction of the BANDING-SET cohort meeting the model definition
  inflow   <- reg$valor[reg$id == "B01"] * frac_mod    # new cases/year in the network
  H_bia    <- 20
  # Each annual cohort is simulated with the horizon remaining until year 20
  coh <- lapply(0:(H_bia - 1), function(k) run_all(build_p(v_base, H_bia - k), 1))
  # Calendar year y: the cohort entering in year k + 1 contributes its cycle t = y − k (t ≥ 1), plus
  # cycle 0 (initial procedure) in its own year of entry
  budget <- map_dfr(1:H_bia, function(y) {
    tibble(Year = y, s = c("A", "B", "C"),
           coste = sapply(c("A", "B", "C"), function(st) inflow * sum(sapply(0:(y - 1), function(k) {
             ct <- coh[[k + 1]][[st]]$cost_t; t <- y - k
             (if (t == 1) ct[1] else 0) + (if (t + 1 <= length(ct)) ct[t + 1] else 0) }))))
  })
  # Uptake scenarios (ISPOR): each year's new cohort is managed with EUS plus EBL-SINK in a share u of patients and with
  # current practice (strategy A, EGD surveillance) in the rest; the share is fixed for each entry cohort.
  contrib <- function(st, k, y) { ct <- coh[[k + 1]][[st]]$cost_t; t <- y - k
    (if (t == 1) ct[1] else 0) + (if (t + 1 <= length(ct)) ct[t + 1] else 0) }
  uptake_sc <- list("20% constant" = rep(0.2, H_bia), "50% constant" = rep(0.5, H_bia), "80% constant" = rep(0.8, H_bia),
                    "100% (full replacement)" = rep(1, H_bia), "Gradual: 20% → 80% in 5 years" = c(0.2, 0.35, 0.5, 0.65, rep(0.8, H_bia - 4)))
  bia_up <- imap_dfr(uptake_sc, function(u, nm) map_dfr(1:5, function(y) {
    cur <- inflow * sum(sapply(0:(y - 1), function(k) contrib("A", k, y)))
    new <- inflow * sum(sapply(0:(y - 1), function(k) (1 - u[k + 1]) * contrib("A", k, y) + u[k + 1] * contrib("C", k, y)))
    tibble(Scenario = nm, Year = y, inc = new - cur) })) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = inc, names_prefix = "Year ") |>
    mutate(`5-year total` = rowSums(across(starts_with("Year "))))
  miss_up <- sapply(uptake_sc, function(u) inflow * sum(sapply(0:4, function(k) u[k + 1] *
    (coh[[k + 1]]$A$events[["prog_neo_missed"]] - coh[[k + 1]]$C$events[["prog_neo_missed"]]))))
  bia_up$`Missed progressions avoided (cohorts of years 1–5, 20-year follow-up)` <- miss_up[bia_up$Scenario]
  bia5 <- budget |> filter(Year <= 5) |> pivot_wider(names_from = s, values_from = coste) |>
    mutate(`EUS plus EBL-SINK − EGD` = C - A, `EUS plus EBL-SINK − EUS` = C - B)
  cum <- function(st, what) sum(sapply(0:(H_bia - 1), function(k) { r <- coh[[k + 1]][[st]]
    if (what == "cost") r$cost_disc / (1 + v_base[["X01"]])^k else r$events[[what]] }) * inflow)   # discounted cost; events undiscounted (natural units)
  bia20 <- tibble(Strategy = S_LAB,
                  `Cumulative discounted cost (€)` = sapply(c("A", "B", "C"), cum, what = "cost"),
                  `Missed neoplastic progressions` = sapply(c("A", "B", "C"), cum, what = "prog_neo_missed"),
                  `Person-years under surveillance` = sapply(c("A", "B", "C"), cum, what = "py_surv"),
                  `Total AEs` = sapply(c("A", "B", "C"), function(st) sum(sapply(c("n_ae_ebl", "n_ae_er", "n_ae_endo", "n_ae_fnb"), function(e) cum(st, e)))))
}
```

```{r bia-tbl}
if (!listo) html_warn("Waiting for the pending parameters.") else {
  cat("<p>The previous analyses are per patient, but a decision-maker also needs the yearly budget. Here the model follows an open cohort: every year about ", round(inflow),
      " new patients enter. This figure corresponds to the ", fmt_n(reg$valor[reg$id == "B01"], 0), " patients per year with SETs ≤15 mm referred to the seven BANDING-SET centres in 2017–2020 (Bas-Cutrina 2023), multiplied by the ",
      fmt_n(100 * frac_mod, 0), "% who, in BANDING-SET, met the model's definition (≤10 mm, oesophageal or gastric, incidental). The first table shows the undiscounted annual spending of each strategy if it were applied to all new patients.</p>\n", sep = "")
  sjd_kable(bia5 |> mutate(across(-Year, ~ fmt_n(.x, 2))) |> rename(`A (EGD)` = A, `B (EUS)` = B, `C (EUS plus EBL-SINK)` = C, `C − A` = `EUS plus EBL-SINK − EGD`, `C − B` = `EUS plus EBL-SINK − EUS`),
            caption = tab_n("Annual budget impact in the BANDING-SET network, years 1 to 5 (2025 €, undiscounted)"),
            nota = paste0("A = ", sub("^[ABC]\\. ", "", S_LAB[["A"]]), "; B = ", sub("^[ABC]\\. ", "", S_LAB[["B"]]), "; C = ", sub("^[ABC]\\. ", "", S_LAB[["C"]]), "; C − A and C − B = additional spending with EUS plus EBL-SINK. Annual inflow = ", fmt_n(reg$valor[reg$id == "B01"], 0), " candidates/year (Bas-Cutrina 2023: 273 in 36 months, 7 centres) × ",
                          flow$an, "/", flow$total, " (fraction of BANDING-SET with an incidental oesophagogastric SET ≤10 mm) = ",
                          fmt_n(inflow, 1), " new cases/year. Undiscounted, as recommended by budget impact guidelines.")) |> cat_k()
  cat("<p>In practice a new technique is adopted gradually. The second table compares current practice (EGD surveillance for everyone) with scenarios in which EUS plus EBL-SINK is used in 20%, 50%, 80% or 100% of new patients, or is introduced progressively from 20% to 80% over five years. It shows the additional annual spending and the missed progressions avoided.</p>\n")
  sjd_kable(bia_up |> mutate(across(starts_with("Year "), ~ fmt_n(.x, 2)), `5-year total` = fmt_n(`5-year total`, 2),
                             across(starts_with("Missed"), ~ fmt_n(.x, 1))),
            caption = tab_n("Additional annual spending with progressive adoption of EUS plus EBL-SINK versus current practice (2025 €, undiscounted)"),
            nota = "Current practice = strategy A (EGD surveillance) for all new patients. The adoption share is fixed for each yearly entry cohort. Missed progressions avoided are counted over the 20-year follow-up of the patients entering in years 1–5.") |> cat_k()
  cat("<p>The last table adds up the whole 20-year period for the network if each strategy were applied to all new patients: total discounted cost, missed progressions, person-years under surveillance and adverse events.</p>\n")
  sjd_kable(bia20 |> mutate(`Cumulative discounted cost (€)` = fmt_n(`Cumulative discounted cost (€)`, 2), across(c(-Strategy, -`Cumulative discounted cost (€)`), ~ fmt_n(.x, 1))),
            caption = tab_n("Cumulative 20-year results of the open cohort in the BANDING-SET network"),
            nota = "Costs discounted at 3% within each cohort and to the year of entry of each cohort; clinical events undiscounted.") |> cat_k()
  clear_float()
}

# Sensitivity analysis

```{r psa-run, cache = nzchar(Sys.getenv("EFI_CACHE_DIR")), cache.path = Sys.getenv("EFI_CACHE_DIR", "cache/"), cache.extra = list(tools::md5sum(reg_path), params$n_psa, params$n_dom, deparse(run_stratum), deparse(build_p), deparse(draw_row), deparse(draw_psa))}
if (listo) {
  set.seed(2026)
  n_psa <- params$n_psa
  M <- draw_psa(n_psa)
  psa_one <- function(i) {
    r <- run_all(build_p(M[i, ]), N = 1000)
    tibble(iter = i, s = c("A", "B", "C"),
           cost = map_dbl(r, ~ .x$cost_disc) / 1000,
           missed = map_dbl(r, ~ .x$events["prog_neo_missed"]),              # undiscounted count
           missed_d = map_dbl(r, ~ .x$events_disc["prog_neo_missed"]),       # discounted at the same rate as costs
           py = map_dbl(r, ~ .x$events["py_surv"]),
           er_b = map_dbl(r, ~ .x$events["n_er_benign"]))
  }
  # Values are sampled beforehand (M), so parallelising does not change the results
  n_cores <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "unix") min(4L, parallel::detectCores()) else 1L
  psa <- bind_rows(parallel::mclapply(seq_len(n_psa), psa_one, mc.cores = n_cores))
  # dE = discounted effect (used whenever cost and effect are combined); dN = undiscounted count (NNT, clinical counts)
  inc <- psa |> select(iter, s, cost, missed, missed_d) |> pivot_wider(names_from = s, values_from = c(cost, missed, missed_d)) |>
    mutate(dC_A = cost_C - cost_A, dE_A = missed_d_A - missed_d_C, dN_A = missed_A - missed_C,
           dC_B = cost_C - cost_B, dE_B = missed_d_B - missed_d_C, dN_B = missed_B - missed_C)
  quad <- function(dC, dE) case_when(dC < 0 & dE > 0 ~ "SE: lower cost, more progressions avoided",
                                       dC > 0 & dE > 0 ~ "NE: higher cost, more progressions avoided",
                                       dC < 0 & dE < 0 ~ "SW: lower cost, fewer progressions avoided",
                                       TRUE ~ "NW: higher cost, fewer progressions avoided")
  inc$quad_A <- quad(inc$dC_A, inc$dE_A)
}
```

## Probabilistic analysis: cost-effectiveness plane {.tabset}

### Table {-}

```{r psa-tbl}
if (!listo) html_warn("Waiting for the pending parameters.") else {
  qt <- inc |> count(quad_A) |> mutate(Probability = paste0(fmt_n(100 * n / sum(n), 1), "%")) |> rename(Quadrant = quad_A, Iterations = n)
  fi <- fieller_ci(inc$dE_A / 1000, inc$dC_A)
  sjd_kable(qt, caption = tab_n("Probability of each quadrant, EUS plus EBL-SINK vs EGD surveillance"),
            nota = paste0(format(n_psa, big.mark = ","), " iterations; effect = missed neoplastic progressions avoided per patient, discounted at 3% like costs. ",
                          "Mean incremental cost ", fmt_n(mean(inc$dC_A), 2), " € per patient (Monte Carlo SE ", fmt_n(sd(inc$dC_A) / sqrt(n_psa), 2), "). ",
                          "Ratio of means ", fmt_n(fi$point, 2), " € per progression avoided", if (fi$type == "finite") paste0(" (Fieller 95%: ", fmt_n(fi$ci[1], 2), " to ", fmt_n(fi$ci[2], 2), ")") else " (Fieller CI unbounded)",
                          "; only interpretable together with the quadrant.")) |> cat_k()
  clear_float()
}
```

```{r psa-ui}
if (listo) {
  ui <- function(x, d = 2) paste0(fmt_n(mean(x), d), " (", fmt_n(quantile(x, 0.025), d), " to ", fmt_n(quantile(x, 0.975), d), ")")
  nnt_ui <- function(dn) {                                   # NNT from undiscounted missed progressions avoided per 1,000 (clinical count)
    qq <- quantile(dn, c(0.025, 0.975)); m <- 1000 / mean(dn)
    if (all(qq > 0)) paste0(fmt_n(m, 1), " (", fmt_n(1000 / qq[2], 1), " to ", fmt_n(1000 / qq[1], 1), ")")
    else paste0(fmt_n(m, 1), " (interval includes no effect)")
  }
  ratio_ui <- function(dC, dE) {
    # Ratio of means with a percentile interval of the simulated ratios. Dominated simulations (higher cost, fewer
    # progressions avoided) are ranked as +Inf and dominant ones (lower cost, more avoided) as -Inf, so that every
    # simulation is ordered by value for money; the interval is reported only if no simulation falls in the
    # south-west quadrant and each off-diagonal quadrant holds less than 2.5% of simulations.
    m <- mean(dC) / (mean(dE) / 1000)
    nw <- dC > 0 & dE <= 0; se <- dC <= 0 & dE > 0; sw <- dC <= 0 & dE <= 0
    if (!any(sw) && mean(nw) < 0.025 && mean(se) < 0.025) {
      r <- dC / (dE / 1000); r[nw] <- Inf; r[se] <- -Inf
      qq <- quantile(r, c(0.025, 0.975), type = 1)
      paste0(fmt_n(m, 2), " (", fmt_n(qq[1], 2), " to ", fmt_n(qq[2], 2), ")")
    } else paste0(fmt_n(m, 2), " (not estimable: simulations spread across quadrants)")
  }
  col_for <- function(dC, dN, dE) c(ui(dC), ui(dN), nnt_ui(dN), ui(dE), ratio_ui(dC, dE),
                                    fmt_n(100 * mean(dC > 0 & dE > 0), 1), fmt_n(100 * mean(dC < 0 & dE > 0), 1))
  pui <- tibble(Outcome = c("Incremental cost (€ per patient)", "Missed progressions avoided per 1,000 (undiscounted)",
                            "Number needed to treat (undiscounted)", "Missed progressions avoided per 1,000 (discounted)",
                            "Cost per missed progression avoided (€; ratio of means)",
                            "Probability of higher cost and more effect (%)", "Probability of lower cost and more effect (%)"),
                `C − A` = col_for(inc$dC_A, inc$dN_A, inc$dE_A),
                `C − B` = col_for(inc$dC_B, inc$dN_B, inc$dE_B))
  sjd_kable(pui, caption = tab_n("Probabilistic results of EUS plus EBL-SINK versus each surveillance strategy: means and 95% uncertainty intervals"),
            nota = paste0(format(n_psa, big.mark = ","), " simulations. Values are means (95% uncertainty interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the simulations), ",
                          "which reflect parameter uncertainty. The number needed to treat is a clinical count: 1,000 divided by the undiscounted missed progressions avoided per 1,000; its interval is obtained by inverting the interval of missed progressions avoided. Because the cost per missed progression avoided uses discounted effects, it is not equal to the NNT multiplied by the incremental cost. ",
                          "The cost per missed progression avoided is the ratio of mean incremental cost to mean discounted effect; its interval is the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the simulated ratios, with dominated simulations ranked as the least favourable (fewer than 2.5% of simulations lay outside the north-east quadrant). ",
                          "C = EUS plus EBL-SINK; A = EGD surveillance (ESGE); B = selective EUS surveillance (ESGE).")) |> cat_k()
  clear_float()
}
```

### Figure {-}

```{r psa-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
if (listo) {
  # Cost-effectiveness plane against one comparator (blue = EGD surveillance, orange = selective EUS surveillance, as in Figure 3)
  ce_plane <- function(dE, dC, col) {
    ggplot(tibble(dE = dE, dC = dC), aes(x = dE, y = dC)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8, colour = col) +
      stat_ellipse(type = "norm", level = 0.95, colour = sjd_cols["red_dk1"], linetype = "dashed") +
      labs(x = "Missed neoplastic progressions avoided by EUS plus EBL-SINK\n(per 1,000 patients, discounted)",
           y = "Incremental cost of EUS plus EBL-SINK (€ per patient)") + scale_y_continuous(labels = eur_lab) + theme_sjd()
  }
  p_ce   <- ce_plane(inc$dE_A, inc$dC_A, plot_pal[["blue"]])
  p_ce_B <- ce_plane(inc$dE_B, inc$dC_B, plot_pal[["orange"]])
  print(p_ce); fig_cap("Cost-effectiveness plane of the probabilistic analysis, EUS plus EBL-SINK vs EGD surveillance", "Each point is one of the simulations; 95% confidence ellipse")
  save_fig(p_ce, "fig_plano_psa", 8, 6); clear_float()
  print(p_ce_B); fig_cap("Cost-effectiveness plane of the probabilistic analysis, EUS plus EBL-SINK vs selective EUS surveillance", "Each point is one of the simulations; 95% confidence ellipse")
  save_fig(p_ce_B, "fig_plano_psa_B", 8, 6); clear_float()
  html_interp(paste0("Each point is one simulation. ", fmt_n(100 * mean(inc$dC_A > 0), 2), "% of the points lie above the horizontal zero line (EUS plus EBL-SINK more costly) and ", fmt_n(100 * mean(inc$dE_A > 0), 2), "% to the right of the vertical zero line (EUS plus EBL-SINK avoids undetected progressions). The parameters that drive this spread are identified in the one-way analysis (section 10.3) and the value-of-information analysis (section 10.9)."))
}

## Acceptability curve and net monetary benefit {.tabset}

```{r ceac-calc}
if (listo) {
  wtp <- seq(0, 50000, by = 1000)
  ceac <- map_dfr(wtp, function(l) {
    nmb <- psa |> mutate(nmb = l * (-missed_d / 1000) - cost) |> group_by(iter) |> mutate(best = nmb == max(nmb)) |> ungroup()
    nmb |> group_by(s) |> summarise(prob = mean(best), nmb = mean(nmb), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(wtp = l)
  })
}
```

### Table {-}

```{r ceac-tbl}
if (!listo) html_warn("Waiting for the pending parameters.") else {
  ct <- ceac |> filter(wtp %in% c(0, 5000, 10000, 20000, 30000, 50000)) |>
    transmute(`WTP (€ per progression avoided)` = fmt_n(wtp, 2), Strategy = S_LAB[s],
              `Probability of being optimal` = paste0(fmt_n(100 * prob, 1), "%"), `Mean NMB (€/patient)` = fmt_n(nmb, 2))
  sjd_kable(ct, caption = tab_n("Probability of being the optimal strategy and net monetary benefit, exploratory thresholds"),
            nota = "There is no accepted threshold per progression avoided; the range is exploratory, as the editor indicates.") |> cat_k()
  clear_float()
}
```

### Figure {-}

```{r ceac-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
if (listo) {
  p_ceac <- ggplot(ceac, aes(x = wtp, y = prob, colour = S_LAB[s])) + geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = strat_cols) + scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = eur_lab) + labs(x = "Exploratory WTP (€ per missed neoplastic progression avoided)", y = "Probability of being optimal", colour = NULL) + theme_sjd()
  print(p_ceac); fig_cap("Multi-strategy acceptability curve")
  save_fig(p_ceac, "fig_ceac", 8, 4.5); clear_float()
  html_interp("For each value attributed to avoiding an undetected progression, the curve shows which strategy is most likely to maximise the net benefit.")
}
```

### Interpretation {-}

```{r ceac-interp}
if (listo) {
  html_interp("As requested by the editor (comment 10), the CEAC and the net monetary benefit are shown over an exploratory range of values, because there is no accepted willingness-to-pay threshold per progression avoided.")
  lam_A <- mean(inc$dC_A) / (mean(inc$dE_A) / 1000); lam_B <- mean(inc$dC_B) / (mean(inc$dE_B) / 1000)
  best <- ceac |> group_by(wtp) |> slice_max(nmb, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> ungroup()
  first_C <- best$wtp[best$s == "C"][1]
  html_note(paste0(
    "<b>How to read the net monetary benefit (NMB).</b> For each strategy, NMB = WTP × (− missed neoplastic progressions per patient) − cost per patient, where WTP is the value a decision-maker attaches to avoiding one missed progression. ",
    "Because the model counts only costs and missed progressions (no health gains in QALYs), every NMB is negative: it is the net cost of the strategy once its missed progressions are valued in euros. ",
    "The strategy with the highest (least negative) NMB is the preferred one at that WTP, and the difference in NMB between two strategies is the incremental net benefit. ",
    "Compared with EGD surveillance, EUS plus EBL-SINK has the higher NMB once WTP exceeds about ", fmt_n(lam_A, 2), " € per progression avoided (its mean incremental cost per progression avoided); ",
    "compared with selective EUS surveillance, once WTP exceeds about ", fmt_n(lam_B, 2), " €. ",
    if (!is.na(first_C)) paste0("In the grid explored, EUS plus EBL-SINK has the highest mean NMB of the three strategies from a WTP of ", fmt_n(first_C, 2), " €. ") else "Within the range explored, EUS plus EBL-SINK never has the highest mean NMB. ",
    "The acceptability curve adds uncertainty: it gives, for each WTP, the proportion of simulations in which each strategy has the highest NMB."))
} else html_warn("Waiting for the pending parameters.")
```

## One-way analysis on input parameters {.tabset}

```{r owsa-calc}
if (listo) {
  ow_ids <- reg |> filter(!is.na(valor), (!is.na(ic_bajo) & !is.na(ic_alto))) |> filter(!(id %in% c("P01", "V01", "V02", "V03", "H03"))) |> pull(id)
  delta <- function(v) { r <- run_all(build_p(v), 1000)
    c(dC = (r$C$cost_disc - r$A$cost_disc) / 1000, dE = r$A$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]],
      dC_B = (r$C$cost_disc - r$B$cost_disc) / 1000, dE_B = r$B$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]]) }
  b0 <- delta(v_base)
  owsa <- map_dfr(ow_ids, function(id) {
    lo <- v_base; hi <- v_base; lo[id] <- reg$ic_bajo[reg$id == id]; hi[id] <- reg$ic_alto[reg$id == id]
    dl <- delta(lo); dh <- delta(hi)
    tibble(id = id, Parámetro = reg$parametro[reg$id == id], dC_lo = dl["dC"], dC_hi = dh["dC"], dE_lo = dl["dE"], dE_hi = dh["dE"],
           dC_lo_B = dl["dC_B"], dC_hi_B = dh["dC_B"], dE_lo_B = dl["dE_B"], dE_hi_B = dh["dE_B"])
  }) |> mutate(rango = abs(dC_hi - dC_lo)) |> arrange(desc(rango))
}
```

### Table {-}

```{r owsa-tbl}
if (!listo) html_warn("Waiting for the pending parameters.") else {
  sjd_kable(owsa |> transmute(Id = id, Parameter = Parámetro,
                              `ΔC vs EGD, lower` = fmt_n(dC_lo, 2), `ΔC vs EGD, upper` = fmt_n(dC_hi, 2), `ΔE vs EGD, lower` = fmt_n(dE_lo, 2), `ΔE vs EGD, upper` = fmt_n(dE_hi, 2),
                              `ΔC vs EUS, lower` = fmt_n(dC_lo_B, 2), `ΔC vs EUS, upper` = fmt_n(dC_hi_B, 2), `ΔE vs EUS, lower` = fmt_n(dE_lo_B, 2), `ΔE vs EUS, upper` = fmt_n(dE_hi_B, 2)),
            caption = tab_n("One-way analysis: input parameters at the limits of their 95% CI or plausible range"),
            nota = paste0(id_legend(owsa$id), " ΔC = incremental cost of EUS plus EBL-SINK vs the comparator (€/patient); ΔE = missed neoplastic progressions avoided per 1,000 patients, discounted at 3%; lower/upper = parameter at its lower/upper limit. Base case vs EGD: ΔC = ",
                          fmt_n(b0["dC"], 2), ", ΔE = ", fmt_n(b0["dE"], 2), "; vs EUS: ΔC = ", fmt_n(b0["dC_B"], 2), ", ΔE = ", fmt_n(b0["dE_B"], 2), ". Each row re-runs the full model.")) |> cat_k()
  clear_float()
}
```

### Figure {-}

```{r owsa-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
if (listo) {
  top <- owsa |> slice_max(rango, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) |> arrange(rango) |> mutate(y = row_number(), lab = str_wrap(gsub(" — ", ", ", Parámetro), 45))
  td <- top |> select(y, dC_lo, dC_hi) |> pivot_longer(c(dC_lo, dC_hi), names_to = "lim", values_to = "v") |>
    mutate(lim = ifelse(lim == "dC_lo", "Parameter at its lower limit", "Parameter at its upper limit"),
           xmin = pmin(b0[["dC"]], v), xmax = pmax(b0[["dC"]], v), dev = abs(v - b0[["dC"]])) |>
    arrange(y, desc(dev))                                   # the shorter bar is drawn on top if both fall on the same side
  p_tor <- ggplot(td) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = y - 0.35, ymax = y + 0.35, fill = lim), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = b0[["dC"]], linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean(inc$dC_A), linetype = "dotted") +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = top$y, labels = top$lab, expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Parameter at its lower limit" = plot_pal[["orange"]], "Parameter at its upper limit" = plot_pal[["blue"]])) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = eur_lab) +
    labs(x = "Incremental cost of EUS plus EBL-SINK vs EGD surveillance (€ per patient)", y = NULL, fill = NULL) + theme_sjd() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  print(p_tor); fig_cap("Tornado diagram of the incremental cost", "The 15 most influential input parameters; dashed line = deterministic base case; dotted line = mean of the probabilistic analysis (expected value). The table lists all of them")
  save_fig(p_tor, "fig_tornado_coste", 9, 7); clear_float()
  html_interp("Unlike the previous analysis, each bar comes from re-running the model with one input parameter at its limit; no variable is an output of the model itself.")
}
```

### Interpretation {-}

```{r owsa-interp}

```

## Structural scenarios {.tabset}

```{r scen-calc}
if (listo) {
  sc <- list(
    "Base case" = function(p) p,
    "2-year EGD interval (ESGE)" = function(p) { p$int_egd <- 2; p$int_eus <- 2; p },
    "10-year horizon" = function(p) { p$horizon <- 10; p$qx <- p$qx[1:10]; p },
    "5-year horizon" = function(p) { p$horizon <- 5; p$qx <- p$qx[1:5]; p },
    "Resection outcomes cited by ESGE (Deprez et al., 2022; 0.86 en bloc; 0.18 AEs)" = function(p) { p$er_complete <- 0.86; p$er_ae <- 0.18; p },
    "Unknown histology all benign" = function(p) { k <- sum(hc); u <- n_an - k; p$pi <- c(B = hc[["Benign"]] + u, G = hc[["GIST"]], N = hc[["NET"]]) / n_an; p },
    "Unknown histology all neoplastic" = function(p) { k <- sum(hc); u <- n_an - k; g <- hc[["GIST"]] / (hc[["GIST"]] + hc[["NET"]]); p$pi <- c(B = hc[["Benign"]], G = hc[["GIST"]] + u * g, N = hc[["NET"]] + u * (1 - g)) / n_an; p },
    "Discount 0%" = function(p) { p$disc <- 0; p },
    "Discount 5%" = function(p) { p$disc <- 0.05; p },
    "ESD for deep lesions (Loras et al., 2018)" = function(p) { p$c_er_deep <- reg$valor[reg$id == "C04"] * reg$valor[reg$id == "C16"]; p },
    "Published EBL-SINK AEs (4.9%; 1.2 nights)" = function(p) { p$p_ae_ebl <- reg$valor[reg$id == "E08"]; p$c_stay <- p$c_stay * reg$valor[reg$id == "E09"]; p }
  )
  scen <- imap_dfr(sc, function(f, nm) {
    r <- run_all(f(build_p(v_base)), 1000)
    tibble(Scenario = nm, dC = (r$C$cost_disc - r$A$cost_disc) / 1000,
           dE = r$A$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]],
           dPY = r$A$events[["py_surv"]] - r$C$events[["py_surv"]],
           dC_B = (r$C$cost_disc - r$B$cost_disc) / 1000,
           dE_B = r$B$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]],
           dPY_B = r$B$events[["py_surv"]] - r$C$events[["py_surv"]])
  })
}
```

### Table {-}

```{r scen-tbl}
if (!listo) html_warn("Waiting for the pending parameters.") else {
  sjd_kable(scen |> mutate(across(dC:dPY_B, ~ fmt_n(.x, 2))) |>
              select(Scenario, `ΔC vs EGD (€/patient)` = dC, `Avoided vs EGD (discounted)` = dE, `PY avoided vs EGD` = dPY,
                     `ΔC vs EUS (€/patient)` = dC_B, `Avoided vs EUS (discounted)` = dE_B, `PY avoided vs EUS` = dPY_B),
            caption = tab_n("Structural scenarios recommended by the editor, EUS plus EBL-SINK vs each surveillance strategy"),
            nota = "Avoided = missed neoplastic progressions avoided per 1,000 patients, discounted at the rate of each scenario (3% in the base case); PY = person-years of surveillance per 1,000 patients, undiscounted. EGD = EGD surveillance (A); EUS = selective EUS surveillance (B).") |> cat_k()
  clear_float()
}

### Figure {-}

```{r scen-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5.5}
if (listo) {
  sl <- bind_rows(scen |> transmute(Scenario, cmp = "EGD surveillance (A)", dC, dE),
                  scen |> transmute(Scenario, cmp = "Selective EUS surveillance (B)", dC = dC_B, dE = dE_B)) |>
    mutate(Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = rev(scen$Scenario)), base = Scenario == "Base case") |>
    pivot_longer(c(dC, dE), names_to = "m", values_to = "v") |>
    mutate(m = factor(m, levels = c("dC", "dE"), labels = c("Incremental cost\n(€ per patient)", "Missed neoplastic progressions avoided\n(per 1,000 patients, discounted)")))
  p_sc <- ggplot(sl, aes(x = v, y = Scenario, colour = cmp)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_point(aes(shape = base), size = 2.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    facet_wrap(~ m, scales = "free_x") + scale_x_continuous(labels = eur_lab) + expand_limits(x = 0) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("EGD surveillance (A)" = unname(strat_cols[1]), "Selective EUS surveillance (B)" = unname(strat_cols[2]))) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 17, `FALSE` = 16), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = "EUS plus EBL-SINK compared with:") + theme_sjd() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  print(p_sc); fig_cap("Cost and effect of EUS plus EBL-SINK vs each surveillance strategy in each scenario",
                       "Triangles = base case; solid line = zero")
  save_fig(p_sc, "fig_escenarios", 9, 5.5); clear_float()
  dE0 <- scen$dE[scen$Scenario == "Base case"]
  sc_mv <- scen |> filter(Scenario != "Base case") |> arrange(desc(abs(dE - dE0)))     # scenarios that move the effect most (vs EGD)
  all_pos <- all(c(scen$dC, scen$dE, scen$dE_B) > 0)
  html_interp(paste0("How to read it: the left panel shows how much more EUS plus EBL-SINK costs per patient in each scenario, and the right panel how many undetected progressions it avoids, against each surveillance strategy. ",
                     if (all_pos && all(scen$dC_B > 0)) "All points lie to the right of zero in both panels: in no scenario does the conclusion change (higher cost, fewer undetected progressions) against either strategy. "
                     else if (all(c(scen$dE, scen$dE_B) > 0)) "EUS plus EBL-SINK avoids more undetected progressions in every scenario against both strategies; against selective EUS surveillance, its incremental cost changes sign in at least one scenario (see the table). "
                     else "In at least one scenario the sign of the effect changes; see the table. ",
                     "Against EGD surveillance, the effect moves most in the scenarios '", sc_mv$Scenario[1], "' (", fmt_n(sc_mv$dE[1], 2), " per 1,000) and '", sc_mv$Scenario[2], "' (", fmt_n(sc_mv$dE[2], 2),
                     "), compared with ", fmt_n(dE0, 2), " in the base case."))
}
```

```{r scen-interp}

```

```{r thr-calc}

           dE_B = r$B$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]], dC_B = (r$C$cost_disc - r$B$cost_disc) / 1000) })
  cruce <- thr$p_res[which(diff(sign(thr$dE)) != 0) + 1][1]
  cruce_B <- thr$p_res[which(diff(sign(thr$dE_B)) != 0) + 1][1]

## Threshold analysis of EUS detection {.tabset}

The model assumes that EUS detects every progression (V09 = 1; assumption 6 in section 7), because progression is defined by EUS measurement in the source studies and no study has measured the sensitivity of EUS for growth. EUS can, however, miss or underestimate growth. This analysis lowers the detection of growth by EUS from 100% to 50%. Because the detection by EGD (V08) is defined relative to EUS, it falls in the same proportion. EUS is used by selective EUS surveillance for deep-layer lesions and by EUS plus EBL-SINK in its EUS years, so the comparison with both surveillance strategies is shown.

```{r thr-eus-calc}
if (listo) {
  grid_eus <- seq(0.5, 1, by = 0.05)
  thr_eus <- map_dfr(grid_eus, function(x) { v <- v_base; v["V09"] <- x; r <- run_all(build_p(v), 1000)
    tibble(se_eus = x,
           dE_A = r$A$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]], dC_A = (r$C$cost_disc - r$A$cost_disc) / 1000,
           dE_B = r$B$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]] - r$C$events_disc[["prog_neo_missed"]], dC_B = (r$C$cost_disc - r$B$cost_disc) / 1000) })
  cross_at <- function(y) { k <- which(diff(sign(y)) != 0); if (length(k)) thr_eus$se_eus[k[1] + 1] else NA_real_ }
  cruce_eus_A <- cross_at(thr_eus$dE_A); cruce_eus_B <- cross_at(thr_eus$dE_B)
}
```

### Table {-}

```{r thr-eus-tbl}

            caption = tab_n("Threshold analysis on the detection of growth by EUS"),
            nota = paste0("Avoided = missed neoplastic progressions avoided by EUS plus EBL-SINK per 1,000 patients, discounted at 3%; ΔC = cost of EUS plus EBL-SINK minus that of the comparator. Base case V09 = 1 (assumption). Detection by EGD = V08 × V09. ",
                          if (is.na(cruce_eus_A) && is.na(cruce_eus_B)) "There is no change of sign within the range explored." else "The sign of the effect changes within the range explored (see the interpretation).")) |> cat_k()

      "<b>The x-axis is how good EUS is at spotting growth.</b> The model assumes that when a patient has an EUS and the lesion has grown, EUS always sees it (100%, the right-hand edge, \"base case\"). No study has measured this, so the plot asks what happens if EUS misses some cases. ",
      "EGD's ability is defined in the model as a fraction of EUS's. Thus, when EUS gets worse, EGD gets worse in the same proportion.<br><br>",
      "<b>The y-axis is EUS plus EBL-SINK's advantage,</b> that is, how many fewer progressions go unnoticed per 1,000 patients with EUS plus EBL-SINK than with surveillance. Higher means a bigger advantage for EUS plus EBL-SINK; zero means no difference.<br><br>",
      "<b>At 100% EUS sensitivity (base case)</b>, EUS plus EBL-SINK avoids ", fmt_n(e_hi$dE_A, 1), " undetected progressions per 1,000 patients against EGD surveillance and ", fmt_n(e_hi$dE_B, 1),
      " against selective EUS surveillance. As we move left and the tests get worse, both lines go up, reaching ", fmt_n(e_lo$dE_A, 1), " and ", fmt_n(e_lo$dE_B, 1), " at ", fmt_n(100 * e_lo$se_eus, 0), "%. ",
      "This suggests that <b>surveillance depends entirely on the tests' ability to detect growth</b>, so worse tests mean more missed progressions. Since EUS plus EBL-SINK deals with most lesions at the start, it depends much less on later checks."))
  } else {

                       ifelse(is.na(cruce_eus_A), "—", paste0(fmt_n(100 * cruce_eus_A, 0), "%")), "; vs EUS from ", ifelse(is.na(cruce_eus_B), "—", paste0(fmt_n(100 * cruce_eus_B, 0), "%")),
                       "), so the conclusion depends on how well EUS detects growth."))
  }
}

## Value of information (EVPI and EVPPI) {.tabset}

The **probabilistic analysis** shows **how uncertain** the results are; the **value-of-information analysis** shows **which sources of uncertainty matter for the decision**. In this sense:

* **Expected value of perfect information (EVPI):** the expected loss associated with making a decision under current uncertainty. It represents the maximum amount, **per patient**, that a decision-maker should be willing to pay to eliminate all uncertainty about the model parameters.
* **Expected value of partial perfect information (EVPPI):** the expected value of eliminating uncertainty in a specific group of parameters while uncertainty in the remaining parameters is retained. It therefore identifies **which groups of parameters would be most valuable to investigate further.**

**Both measures depend on the value assigned to avoiding a missed neoplastic progression** and are therefore presented over the same exploratory range as the cost-effectiveness acceptability curve. EVPPI is estimated from the `r format(params$n_psa, big.mark = ',')` probabilistic iterations using the non-parametric regression approach described by Strong et al. (2014), based on generalised additive models of incremental costs and incremental progressions avoided conditional on each parameter group.

```{r voi-calc, cache = nzchar(Sys.getenv("EFI_CACHE_DIR")), cache.path = Sys.getenv("EFI_CACHE_DIR", "cache/"), cache.extra = list(tools::md5sum(reg_path), params$n_psa, deparse(run_stratum), deparse(build_p), deparse(draw_row), deparse(draw_psa))}
if (listo) {
  wide <- psa |> select(iter, s, cost, missed = missed_d) |> pivot_wider(names_from = s, values_from = c(cost, missed)) |> arrange(iter)   # discounted effects
  # incremental cost and incremental missed progressions of B and C versus A (per patient; per 1,000 patients)
  dC <- cbind(B = wide$cost_B - wide$cost_A, C = wide$cost_C - wide$cost_A)
  dM <- cbind(B = wide$missed_B - wide$missed_A, C = wide$missed_C - wide$missed_A)
  nb_inc <- function(l, gC, gM) -gC - l * gM / 1000              # incremental net benefit vs A (€ per patient)
  evpi_fun <- function(l, gC = dC, gM = dM) {
    inb <- cbind(A = 0, nb_inc(l, gC, gM)); mean(apply(inb, 1, max)) - max(colMeans(inb))
  }
  voi_groups <- list(
    "Natural history (progression rates)"       = c("H02", "H04", "H05", "H06"),
    "Histology mix and layer of origin"         = c("P03", "P04", "P05", "P06"),
    "EBL-SINK outcomes and residual disease"    = c("E01", "E02", "E03", "E04", "E05", "E07", "H07"),
    "Surveillance attendance and detection"     = c("V07", "V08", "V09"),
    "Diagnosis and treatment after progression" = c("D01", "T01", "T02"),
    "Costs"                                     = reg$id[grepl("^C", reg$id)]
  )
  Mv <- M[order(seq_len(nrow(M))), , drop = FALSE]
  voi_fit <- function(ids) {
    ids <- ids[ids %in% colnames(Mv)]
    ids <- ids[apply(Mv[, ids, drop = FALSE], 2, function(x) isTRUE(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0))]
    if (!length(ids)) return(NULL)
    X <- as.data.frame(Mv[, ids, drop = FALSE]); names(X) <- paste0("x", seq_along(ids))
    fml <- as.formula(paste("y ~", paste0("s(", names(X), ", k = 5)", collapse = " + ")))
    fit1 <- function(y) fitted(mgcv::bam(fml, data = cbind(y = y, X), discrete = TRUE))
    list(ids = ids, gC = sapply(c("B", "C"), function(k) fit1(dC[, k])), gM = sapply(c("B", "C"), function(k) fit1(dM[, k])))
  }
  voi_fits <- lapply(voi_groups, voi_fit)
  wtp_voi <- seq(0, 50000, by = 2500)
  voi <- map_dfr(wtp_voi, function(l) {
    bind_rows(tibble(Group = "All parameters (EVPI)", wtp = l, value = evpi_fun(l)),
              imap_dfr(compact(voi_fits), function(f, g) tibble(Group = g, wtp = l, value = max(0, evpi_fun(l, f$gC, f$gM)))))
  })
}
```

  grp_ids["Costs"] <- "C01–C18"
  vt <- vt |> mutate(Parameters = grp_ids[Group], .after = Group)

Values are per patient; multiply by the number of patients affected by the decision to obtain the population value. Parameters that are fixed in the probabilistic analysis (unit costs, V09, T03, T04) have no EVPPI; their influence is shown in the one-way analysis (section 10.3).")) |> cat_k()

## Summary figure of the sensitivity analyses {.unnumbered}

```{r sens-summary, fig.width=12, fig.height=11}
if (listo) {

  # A. One-way analysis on the incremental effect (10 most influential parameters, either comparator)

  # Dashed line = deterministic base case; dotted line = mean of the probabilistic analysis (expected value)
  owl <- bind_rows(ow_e |> transmute(lab, cmp = "EGD surveillance (A)", lo = pmin(dE_lo, dE_hi), hi = pmax(dE_lo, dE_hi), base = b0[["dE"]], ev = mean(inc$dE_A)),

  # B. One-way analysis on the incremental cost (10 most influential parameters, either comparator)
  ow_c <- owsa |> mutate(rng = pmax(abs(dC_hi - dC_lo), abs(dC_hi_B - dC_lo_B))) |> slice_max(rng, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    arrange(rng) |> mutate(lab = factor(lab_fig(Parámetro), levels = unique(lab_fig(Parámetro))))
  owc <- bind_rows(ow_c |> transmute(lab, cmp = "EGD surveillance (A)", lo = pmin(dC_lo, dC_hi), hi = pmax(dC_lo, dC_hi), base = b0[["dC"]], ev = mean(inc$dC_A)),
                   ow_c |> transmute(lab, cmp = "Selective EUS surveillance (B)", lo = pmin(dC_lo_B, dC_hi_B), hi = pmax(dC_lo_B, dC_hi_B), base = b0[["dC_B"]], ev = mean(inc$dC_B)))
  pA2 <- ggplot(owc, aes(y = lab, colour = cmp)) +

    geom_vline(data = distinct(owc, cmp, ev), aes(xintercept = ev, colour = cmp, linetype = "Mean of the probabilistic analysis"), show.legend = c(colour = FALSE, linetype = TRUE)) +

    scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 1.4))) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cmp_cols, name = cmp_lab) + scale_linetype_manual(values = ref_lines, name = NULL) + scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma(accuracy = 1)) +

  pB <- ggplot(scl, aes(x = dE, y = Scenario, colour = cmp, shape = base)) +

    thr_eus |> transmute(x = se_eus, A = dE_A, B = dE_B, an = "Detection of growth by EUS", xb = v_base[["V09"]])) |>
    pivot_longer(c(A, B), names_to = "k", values_to = "dE") |>
    mutate(cmp = ifelse(k == "A", "EGD surveillance (A)", "Selective EUS surveillance (B)"),

  # One titled panel per threshold parameter (same title style as the other panels), common y axis, one shared legend
  ylim_thr <- range(c(0, thl$dE))
  thr_panel <- function(key, tag, ttl, ylab) {
    ggplot(filter(thl, an == key), aes(x = x, y = dE, colour = cmp)) +

      coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_thr) +

  pC <- (thr_panel("Residual disease after disappearance", "A)", "Residual disease", TRUE) |
         thr_panel("Detection of growth by EGD relative to EUS", "B)", "EGD detection relative to EUS", FALSE) |
         thr_panel("Detection of growth by EUS", "C)", "EUS detection", FALSE)) +

  pD <- p_voi + labs(title = expression(bold("D)") ~ "Value of information")) + theme(legend.position = "right")
  # Two manuscript figures: deterministic sensitivity (one-way and scenarios) and threshold + value of information

  p_sens2 <- wrap_elements(full = pC) / wrap_elements(full = pD) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.9))
  print(p_sens1)
  fig_cap("Deterministic sensitivity analyses of EUS plus EBL-SINK against each surveillance strategy",
          "A, B) one-way analysis of the 10 most influential parameters on missed progressions avoided (A) and on the incremental cost (B); bars span the results at the lower and upper limits; dashed lines = deterministic base case; dotted lines = mean of the probabilistic analysis (expected value). C) structural scenarios (triangles = base case); solid lines = zero (no difference between strategies)")
  save_fig(p_sens1, "fig_sensibilidad_determinista", 12, 11); clear_float()
  print(p_sens2)
  fig_cap("Threshold and value-of-information analyses of EUS plus EBL-SINK against each surveillance strategy",
          "A-C) threshold analyses (dotted lines = base case; solid lines = zero, no difference between strategies). D) expected value of perfect information (EVPI, thick line) and of partial perfect information by group of parameters, over an exploratory range of willingness to pay")
  save_fig(p_sens2, "fig_umbrales_voi", 12, 10); clear_float()
  all_e <- c(owl$lo, scl$dE, thl$dE)

" else "At least one one-way or scenario analysis reverses the effect (see the tables). ",

    " These two figures are intended for the manuscript (Figures 3 and 4)."))

# Model checking

This section answers a different question from the sensitivity analysis: **does the code do what it says it does?** To check this, the model is run with made-up values whose answer is known in advance, and the result is verified to be the expected one. For example: if nobody progresses, there can be no progressions; if everyone dies in the first year, at the end of the first year everyone must be in the death state; if there is no discounting, the discounted cost must equal the undiscounted cost; and the three strategies must start with exactly the same 1,000 patients. These tests would have detected the errors of the previous model (arms with different cohorts, or EBL-SINK charged to only some of the patients).

## Code tests {.tabset}

```{r verify-run}
ver <- verify_engine()
```

### Table {-}

```{r verify-tbl}
sjd_kable(ver, caption = tab_n("Internal verification battery of the model engine"),
          nota = "The tests use SYNTHETIC values with a known answer; they are not study parameters and do not produce results. They cover population conservation, the same cohort in the three strategies, extreme values, monotonicity, discounting and face validity (comment 9).") |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(2, width = "30em") |> cat_k()
clear_float()
```

### Figure {-}

```{r verify-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
tr <- run_all(fixture(), 1000)
cons <- map_dfr(names(tr), function(s) tibble(Strategy = S_LAB[s], Cycle = 0:(nrow(tr[[s]]$trace) - 1), Total = rowSums(tr[[s]]$trace)))
p_cons <- ggplot(cons, aes(Cycle, Total, colour = Strategy)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = strat_cols) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(990, 1010)) +
  labs(y = "Sum of all states (N = 1,000)", colour = NULL) + theme_sjd()
print(p_cons); fig_cap("Total number of patients in the model in each year", "Test values. If the model neither loses nor duplicates patients, the three lines stay at 1,000")
save_fig(p_cons, "fig_verificacion_conservacion", 8, 4); clear_float()
html_interp("The three strategies conserve the population exactly in every cycle and start from the same cohort. The check in the previous model could not detect the error of unequal cohorts because it only verified each arm separately.")
```

### Interpretation {-}

```{r verify-interp}
if (all(ver$Result == "Pass")) {
  html_interp(paste0("All ", nrow(ver), " tests pass. The engine conserves the population, starts from the same cohort in the three strategies, ",
                     "behaves as expected at extreme values, counts as missed every progression that is never detected (whether the patient is alive or dead at the end of the horizon) and charges EBL-SINK to 100% of the cohort, which corrects defect B1 of the audit."))
} else html_warn(paste0("Some tests fail: ", paste(ver$Test[ver$Result != "Pass"], collapse = ", "), ". Results must not be interpreted until this is corrected."))
html_note("Face validity against the outcomes observed in BANDING-SET (disappearance at 1 year and adverse events) is guaranteed by construction, because those parameters enter directly from the database. External validation requires an independent cohort with long-term follow-up, which does not exist today.")
if (listo) {
  pp <- build_p(v_base)
  w_layer <- c(sup = 1 - pp$prop_deep, deep = pp$prop_deep)
  implied <- sum(sapply(c("B", "G", "N"), function(h) pp$pi[[h]] * sum(w_layer * p_from_h(pp$lambda[[h]] * c(1, pp$rr_deep), 1))))
  h01 <- reg[reg$id == "H01", ]
  html_interp(paste0("<b>External consistency with Dong et al. (2025).</b> Combining the histology-specific progression rates with the histology mix and the share of deep-layer lesions of BANDING-SET, ",
                     "the model implies an overall annual probability of suspicious progression of ", fmt_n(100 * implied, 2), " per 100 patient-years. ",
                     "The meta-analysis reports ", fmt_n(100 * h01$valor, 1), " per 100 person-years (95% CI ", fmt_n(100 * h01$ic_bajo, 1), "–", fmt_n(100 * h01$ic_alto, 1),
                     ") for SETs <1 cm (H01). ", if (implied >= h01$ic_bajo && implied <= h01$ic_alto) "The model value lies within that interval." else "The model value lies outside that interval and should be reviewed."))
}

```{r key-findings}
if (listo) {
  html_interp(paste0("<b>Main analysis (ESGE surveillance):</b> EUS plus EBL-SINK is not dominant. Compared with EGD surveillance, it costs on average ", fmt_n(mean(inc$dC_A), 2),
                     " € more per patient and avoids ", fmt_n(mean(inc$dN_A), 2), " missed neoplastic progressions per 1,000 patients (undiscounted; NNT ", fmt_n(1000 / mean(inc$dN_A), 1), "; ", fmt_n(mean(inc$dE_A), 2), " discounted at 3%). ",
                     "With costs and effects discounted at 3%, the cost per missed progression avoided is ", fmt_n(mean(inc$dC_A) / (mean(inc$dE_A) / 1000), 2), " €; ",
                     "probability of being less costly and more effective: ", fmt_n(100 * mean(inc$quad_A == "SE: lower cost, more progressions avoided"), 1), "%."))
  html_interp(paste0("<b>Secondary analysis:</b> EUS plus EBL-SINK is dominant when surveillance in the comparator is more intensive or better adhered to than in the base case. ",
                     "With annual examinations and the observed attendance, the probability of dominating EUS surveillance is ", fmt_n(100 * dom_psa$pB[1], 1),
                     "%; with annual examinations and 70% attendance, the probability of dominating EGD surveillance is ", fmt_n(100 * dom_psa$pA[2], 1), "%. ",
                     if (all(c(life$dE_A, life$dE_B) > 0)) "With a lifetime horizon, EUS plus EBL-SINK still avoids more undetected progressions than both surveillance strategies in every scenario explored (section 9.2)."
                     else paste0("With a lifetime horizon, EUS plus EBL-SINK keeps its advantage in effectiveness except against ", life_neg_txt, " (section 9.2).")))
  html_interp(paste0("<b>Burden of missed disease:</b> over 20 years, the cohort spends ", fmt_n(base_tbl["py_undet", "A"], 1), " person-years per 1,000 patients with an undetected progressed neoplasm under EGD surveillance and ",
                     fmt_n(base_tbl["py_undet", "C"], 1), " with EUS plus EBL-SINK (base case). <b>Value of information:</b> the uncertainty that matters most for the decision concerns ",
                     tolower(top$Group[1]), " and ", tolower(top$Group[2]), " (section 10.9)."))
} else {
  html_warn(paste0("<b>There are no reportable results yet.</b> The model, the code verification and the available parameters are complete, ",

  html_interp(paste0("What can already be stated: (1) the real BANDING-SET cohort meeting the editor's definition has ", n_an, " lesions; ",
                     "(2) the diagnostic yield of SINK in this cohort is ", fmt_n(100 * emp$Estimación[emp$id == "E02"], 1), "%, which makes the strategy highly dependent on the 1-year control; ",
                     "(3) the engine corrects the defects of the previous version and passes the ", nrow(ver), " verification tests."))
