# Message to stakeholders

```{r stakeholder-calc}
if (listo) {
  # Key figures (probabilistic means, EUS plus EBL-SINK vs each surveillance strategy)
  sk <- tibble(cmp = c("A", "B"),
               dC = c(mean(inc$dC_A), mean(inc$dC_B)),                 # € per patient
               dN = c(mean(inc$dN_A), mean(inc$dN_B)),                 # missed progressions avoided per 1,000 patients (undiscounted count)
               dE = c(mean(inc$dE_A), mean(inc$dE_B))) |>              # same, discounted at 3% like costs
    mutate(nnt = 1000 / dN, icer = dC / (dE / 1000))           # NNT: clinical count (undiscounted); ratio: costs and effects discounted
  fi_A <- fieller_ci(inc$dE_A / 1000, inc$dC_A); fi_B <- fieller_ci(inc$dE_B / 1000, inc$dC_B)
  py_w <- psa |> select(iter, s, py) |> pivot_wider(names_from = s, values_from = py)
  py_saved <- mean(py_w$A - py_w$C)                                      # person-years of surveillance avoided per 1,000 patients
  und_A <- base_tbl["py_undet", "A"] / 1000; und_C <- base_tbl["py_undet", "C"] / 1000
  bia_rng <- range(bia5$`EUS plus EBL-SINK − EGD`)
  res_ok <- thr$p_res[thr$dE > 0 & thr$dE_B > 0]; res_max <- if (length(res_ok)) max(res_ok) else NA
  life_worse <- any(c(life$dE_A, life$dE_B) < 0)
  r0 <- function(x, by = 1000) fmt_n(round(x / by) * by, 0)
}
```

## Key message

```{r stakeholder-text}
if (listo) {
  cat(paste0(
"For patients with an incidentally detected oesophageal or gastric subepithelial tumour of 10 mm or less, upfront EUS-guided band ligation with single-incision needle-knife biopsy (EBL-SINK) costs more than surveillance as recommended by ESGE. However, it **considerably reduces the number of neoplasms that progress unnoticed** and the **burden of long-term follow-up**.\n\n",
"- **More effective:** compared with EGD surveillance, EUS plus EBL-SINK avoids about **", fmt_n(sk$dN[1], 0), " missed neoplastic progressions per 1,000 patients** over 20 years. ",
"Patients also spend much less time with a growing tumour that nobody has noticed: on average about **", fmt_n(und_C, 1), " years per patient with EUS plus EBL-SINK versus ", fmt_n(und_A, 1), " years with EGD surveillance**.\n",
"- **More costly, at a defined price:** EUS plus EBL-SINK costs about **€", fmt_n(sk$dC[1], 0), " more per patient**. For every **", fmt_n(sk$nnt[1], 0), " patients** treated with EUS plus EBL-SINK instead of EGD surveillance, one tumour progression that would have gone unnoticed is avoided. With costs and effects discounted at 3% a year, as Spanish guidelines recommend, each missed progression avoided costs about **€", r0(sk$icer[1]), "** (section 13.2). ",
"There is no accepted threshold for this outcome, so this figure should not be compared with cost-per-QALY thresholds.\n",
"- **Much less follow-up:** EUS plus EBL-SINK requires about **", r0(py_saved), " fewer person-years of surveillance per 1,000 patients**, which means fewer endoscopies, appointments and waiting-list slots.\n",
"- **Cost-saving where surveillance is intensive:** in centres that follow these lesions every year, EUS plus EBL-SINK is both cheaper and more effective in most simulations; for example, it dominates yearly selective EUS surveillance in **", fmt_n(100 * dom_psa$pB[1], 0), "% of simulations** (section 9.2).\n",
"- **Affordable at network level:** across the seven BANDING-SET centres (about ", round(inflow), " new patients a year), adopting EUS plus EBL-SINK for all eligible patients would add about **€", r0(bia_rng[1]), "–", r0(bia_rng[2]), " a year** to the budget (section 9.3).\n\n",
"**Robustness:** the advantage of EUS plus EBL-SINK holds even if ligation leaves residual tumour in up to ", fmt_n(100 * res_max, 0), "% of the lesions that disappear (although at that level the advantage shrinks to ", fmt_n(min(thr$dE[which.min(abs(thr$p_res - res_max))], thr$dE_B[which.min(abs(thr$p_res - res_max))]), 1), " per 1,000 patients against selective EUS surveillance), and if EGD or EUS detects growth much less well than assumed (sections 10.5–10.7).", if (!life_worse) " It also holds with a lifetime horizon (section 9.2)." else "", "\n\n",
"**What remains uncertain:** EBL-SINK has been followed for only one year. ",
if (life_worse) "With a lifetime horizon and very intensive surveillance in the comparator, residual disease left after ligation can cancel its advantage (section 9.2). " else "",
"The value-of-information analysis shows that the most useful evidence to collect concerns ", tolower(top$Group[1]), ", and ", tolower(top$Group[2]),
" (section 10.9). This is the aim of the planned long-term follow-up of the BANDING-SET cohort.\n\n",
"**In one sentence:** *EUS plus EBL-SINK is a one-off procedure that costs about €", fmt_n(sk$dC[1], 0), " more per patient than ESGE surveillance, but it identifies and treats most potentially malignant lesions at the outset, avoids about ",
fmt_n(sk$dN[1], 0), " missed progressions per 1,000 patients and replaces years of surveillance endoscopies.*\n"))
}
```

## Number needed to treat and cost per missed progression avoided

The cost per missed progression avoided is the extra cost of EUS plus EBL-SINK per patient divided by the number of missed progressions it avoids per patient. Following the Spanish guideline, costs and effects are both discounted at 3% per year, so progressions avoided late in the horizon weigh less than early ones; discounting costs and effects at the same rate avoids the Keeler–Cretin paradox. The number needed to treat (NNT) is a clinical count and is not discounted: it is the number of patients who must receive EUS plus EBL-SINK instead of surveillance to avoid one missed progression over 20 years. Because the ratio uses discounted effects, it is not equal to the NNT multiplied by the extra cost per patient.

```{r stakeholder-nnt}
if (listo) {
  nt <- sk |> mutate(Comparator = c("A (EGD)", "B (EUS)"),
                     `Extra cost of EUS plus EBL-SINK (€/patient)` = fmt_n(dC, 2),
                     `Missed progressions avoided per 1,000 (undiscounted)` = fmt_n(dN, 2),
                     `NNT (= 1,000 ÷ undiscounted avoided per 1,000)` = fmt_n(nnt, 1),
                     `Missed progressions avoided per 1,000 (discounted at 3%)` = fmt_n(dE, 2),
                     `Cost per missed progression avoided (€; costs and effects discounted)` = fmt_n(icer, 2),
                     `Fieller 95% interval (€)` = c(if (fi_A$type == "finite") paste0(fmt_n(fi_A$ci[1], 2), " to ", fmt_n(fi_A$ci[2], 2)) else "unbounded",
                                                    if (fi_B$type == "finite") paste0(fmt_n(fi_B$ci[1], 2), " to ", fmt_n(fi_B$ci[2], 2)) else "unbounded")) |>
    select(Comparator, `Extra cost of EUS plus EBL-SINK (€/patient)`, `Missed progressions avoided per 1,000 (undiscounted)`, `NNT (= 1,000 ÷ undiscounted avoided per 1,000)`,
           `Missed progressions avoided per 1,000 (discounted at 3%)`, `Cost per missed progression avoided (€; costs and effects discounted)`, `Fieller 95% interval (€)`)
  sjd_kable(nt, caption = tab_n("Number needed to treat and cost per missed progression avoided, EUS plus EBL-SINK (C) versus each surveillance strategy"),
            nota = paste0("Means of the ", format(n_psa, big.mark = ","), " probabilistic iterations; 20-year horizon. Costs discounted at 3%. ",
                          "NNT from undiscounted progressions: 1,000 ÷ ", fmt_n(sk$dN[1], 2), " = ", fmt_n(sk$nnt[1], 1), " (vs A). ",
                          "Cost per missed progression avoided from discounted costs and effects: ", fmt_n(sk$dC[1], 2), " € ÷ (", fmt_n(sk$dE[1], 2), " ÷ 1,000) = ", fmt_n(sk$icer[1], 2), " € (vs A). ",
                          "The Fieller interval reflects only Monte Carlo precision of the ratio of means.")) |> cat_k()
  clear_float()
  html_note("A missed progression is a GIST or NET that grows without being detected; not every one would cause clinical harm. The cost per missed progression avoided is therefore not a cost per cancer death or per life saved, and there is no accepted willingness-to-pay threshold for it (section 10.2).")
}
```

  if (file.exists(flow_png) && requireNamespace("png", quietly = TRUE)) {

          (p_ceac + ptitle("C)", "Cost-effectiveness acceptability curve")) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))
  save_fig(fig3, "Figure_2_Probabilistic_analysis", 16, 12)
